_README: Replace this file with your actual GoogleService-Info.plist downloaded from Firebase Console.
steps: 3. Add an iOS app with bundle ID: com.agrismart.app
5. Drag it into Xcode at AgriSmart/ (root, alongside AgriSmartApp.swift)
6. Ensure 'Copy items if needed' is checked
8. Enable Cloud Firestore in Firebase Console
9. Enable Firebase Storage in Firebase Console
10. Enable Firebase Cloud Messaging for push notifications
